funder: U.S. Department of Defense, SERDP and ESTCP
lens: round2: card-listing endpoint discovered from workwithus page JS (ajax-href) + solicitation detail pages
method: html_listing + detail_pages (server-rendered, plain HTTP, no cookies)

row_fix.program: SERDP / ESTCP open solicitations (SERDP Core and SEED FY2028 currently listed; ESTCP not listed yet)
row_fix.reason: Replaces the html monitor on the homepage with the funder's own open-solicitation list; the homepage row stores no opportunity rows.

engine_requirements:
1) GET listing_url with UA SALSAV-GrantWatch/1.0, no cookies (verified 200, 4741 bytes, with and without X-Requested-With). 2) For each match of take the enclosing card: M/D/YYYY -> released_date;
TITLE
-> title (fail loudly if title or GUID is missing). external_id = GUID; url = https://serdp-estcp.mil + href. 3) GET each solicitation url (2 s spacing) and match the case-insensitive sentence 'Proposals are due ' (fallback 'due ') -> deadline (ISO). status = open when deadline >= today; closed otherwise; if deadline is null keep status unknown and do not drop the row. 4) Pagination: the pager is a form POST with ApiRequestParams.NextLink; empty on the current page (single page). Follow only if non-empty, with a cap. 5) Cap detail fetches; log overflow. 6) Change detection on rows, not on raw HTML (the anti-forgery token changes on every request).

summary: SERDP exposes its open solicitations as a stable server-rendered card list at /workwithus/listingcardresults, with title, release date and a deadline on each solicitation page. The current adapters cannot read it. Needs a new html_cards adapter (spec above). Current open list: SERDP Core FY2028 (due 2027-01-07) and SERDP SEED FY2028 (due 2027-03-11). ESTCP has no open call on the list yet. The funder row should point to the listing URL, not the homepage. This replaces the round-1 sitemap approach, which had lastmod and 25-cap problems.
issues: Edge engine has no html_cards adapter yet; nothing can be stored for this funder until one is built and deployed.
Card list shows open calls only; closed calls disappear from it. Store rows as they are seen so history persists.
If a solicitation page has no 'Proposals are due' sentence, deadline is null: keep the row with status unknown and log it.
ESTCP coverage unproven: no ESTCP call on the list now, and the same list may not carry ESTCP calls later.
Program/topic allowlist: the two rows are SERDP FY2028 calls; the funder row is already vetted, so no filter is proposed.
